question: Manoah said, "We are doomed to die!" How did his wife answer him?
options: They had not really seen the angel's face
The angel had promised they would live long
The priest had told them they were safe
If the LORD meant to kill them, He would not have accepted their burnt offering or shown them these things
explanation: His wife reasoned that if the LORD meant to kill them, He would not have accepted their offering or told them all these things.
